text:
maria: putting this up for bikeshed - i sketched an API for recomputes that both console and cli can call. goal: one selector language, quota-aware estimates, and dry-run previews. thoughts?

ajay: nice. one immediate question: if a customer exceeds quota should the API reject or return a recommended schedule? both have pros.

kevin: leaning reject + helpful payload. we should fail fast so users don't queue huge jobs that never run. include estimated_tokens and est_gpu_hours so console can show a cost bar.

liz: UX: show a preview modal with sample rows + a small diff histogram. add a "sample" toggle so QA can eyeball records before running.

maria: current proto payload (very rough):
```json
POST /v1/recompute/select
{
  "selector": "env:prod AND metric:agg_hours AND dt >= 2026-03-01",
  "canary_pct": 10,
  "quota_mode": "check-only", // options: check-only | reserve | consume
  "dry_run": true,
  "preview_size": 250
}
```

carmen: reservation semantics are important. tenants with reserved capacity should be able to "reserve" without touching shared pool. API must return clear error codes when requested reservation > tenant_commit.

ajay: agreed. defaulting to check-only avoids surprises. also API should include a recommended_stagger when estimate > available_quota.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: recompute-select-v1 -> staging @ 2026-03-12T18:00Z :package:

kevin: routing note: scheduler should prefer Dedicated clusters for heavy reprocesses, then Hosted, then fall back to smaller variants. api should surface routing_hint so console shows latency/cost tradeoffs.

liz: small UX ask: label each preview row with which clause matched and give a sample hash to reproduce the preview. show a "risk" badge if sampled diff > 8%.

maria: response should include plan_id and cost_breakdown: e.g. {"plan_id":"str","estimate_tokens":"12345","estimate_gpu_hours":"0.4"} (we'll serialize as strings). also include preview_hash for reproducible sampling.

ajay: include preview_hash + canary_id so we can promote canary -> full with same sample.

carmen: audit requirement: emit an audit event for selector.create and selector.execute with plan_id, user, quota_mode, and estimate. essential for postmortems.

kevin: quota enforcement proposal: if quota exceeded and quota_mode=="consume" return 409 with a suggestions array of windows the user can accept (API endpoint to accept suggestion should auto-reserve slots). example suggestion: [{"start":"2026-03-13T00:00Z","end":"2026-03-13T06:00Z","slots":"2"}] (we'll stringify).

ops-bot: scheduler note: supports slot reservations + preemption today. will need an endpoint to convert suggestions into actual reservations to guarantee availability.

liz: console pieces: cost slider, estimated completion time, preview diff modal, safety gates checkbox (blocking execute unless QA signed off if risk > threshold).

kevin: add downstream impact estimate (db reads, iops) to cost_breakdown so infra can pre-warn on spikes.

ajay: i'll draft the API contract PR including these fields: quota_mode, canary_pct, preview_size, preview_hash, estimated_tokens, estimated_gpu_hours, routing_hint, plan_id, suggestions.

maria: great. sync tomorrow 10am to finalize console mocks + contract. please ping if you want items added beforehand. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: canary rollout started: recompute-select-v1 -> canary-1 :rocket:
